# Selah.fm — Open Source Music Promotion Marketplace
## About
Selah.fm is an open-source CPM (Cost Per Mille) marketplace where artists set budgets and creators earn per verified view on TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts. Artists start at $0.10 CPM ($100 per 1M views). Creators earn ~$1,000 per 1M views at $1 CPM. Platform takes 20%.

## Key pages
- /blog: Music promotion guides, creator earnings tips, and artist growth strategies
- /tools/cpm-calculator: Calculate CPM rates for music promotion campaigns
- /welcome-artists: How artists can promote music by hiring content creators
- /welcome-creators: How content creators earn money making music videos
- /browse: Browse active music promotion campaigns and submit your content
- /faq: Frequently asked questions about music promotion on Selah.fm
- /about: Founder story and platform mission
